description:
Today, we're starting our series on Custom Lighting Models with the most basic and simple type of lighting - vertex lighting. I show 3 simple ways to create ambient light and also how to create Lambert diffuse light.

Take a look at the playlist for the whole series:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL78XDi0TS4lGnGa7L2X4o3UV-XYZEKNwj

Here's last week's video that introduces the series:
https://youtu.be/wI0YdkiduYY
